title: Characteristic polynomial of an endomorphism of a finite free module (in a basis)
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n\ge0$, $N$ a free $R$-module with a basis $e_1,\dots,e_n$, and $\psi:N\to N$ an $R$-linear map, with matrix $X=(x_{ij})\in M_n(R)$ in this basis ($\psi(e_j)=\sum_ix_{ij}e_i$). The *characteristic polynomial of $\psi$ in the basis $e$* is $\det(T\cdot I_n-X)\in R[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring], the determinant of the $n\times n$ matrix over $R[T]$ with entries $T\delta_{ij}-x_{ij}$ (for $n=0$ it is $1$). It is written $\det(T-\psi)$ or $\det(T-\psi\mid N)$ once it is known not to depend on the basis [lem-weil-pbc-charpoly-free-module-properties].
